name: Sovereign Aegis (24h)
description: Envelops your citadel in an impenetrable alchemical forcefield for 24 hours, preventing all scout and attack marches.

name: Arcane Speedup (8h)
description: Infuses construction, research, or troop training queues with temporal magic, reducing remaining duration by 8 hours.

name: Dragon Blood Elixir
description: Potent alchemical mixture that instantly revives 20% of fallen troops in the temple hospital.

name: Imperial March Order
description: Increases maximum march capacity by +50% for 4 hours. Perfect for rallying massive alliance attacks.

name: Citadel Grain Reserve (5M)
description: Instantly adds 5,000,000 grain resources directly to your treasury to sustain large armies.

name: Pouch of Crystals
description: A minor offering of glistening blue Royal Crystals, condensed from pure mana geysers.

name: Chest of Crystals
description: A heavy wooden chest filled with brilliant blue Royal Crystals, granting substantial purchasing power.

name: Sovereign Vault of Crystals
description: An imperial payload of raw Royal Crystals, mined directly from the Crownspire heartlands. Ultimate value.
